releases.name: Behelade
releases.summary: Wield the “Behelade” to fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up and find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the animals go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

releases.name: Resettle
releases.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

releases.name: No Visitors Allowed
releases.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

releases.name: Haunted Echoes
releases.summary: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

releases.name: TURBOCARDS
releases.summary: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell for your computer and your handheld. Play with mouse, keyboard or controller — however you like, on whatever you like. Four skin sets, modifiers and a Daily Challenge with verified deals. Windows, macOS, Linux and SteamOS.

releases.name: Pop Corner
releases.summary: A relaxing match-3 that floats in a corner of your screen with a transparent background. Match coffee mugs, folders and sticky notes while you work, without leaving what you're doing.

releases.name: The Turret and the Hare
releases.summary: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.

releases.name: BlastBeacon
releases.summary: Minesweeper, in first person. Step onto the board deep in dark, ancient ruins, read the glowing numbers, and dig with your pickaxe. Just don't hit the wrong block.

releases.name: Don't Look Back.
releases.summary: 『ふりむいちゃだめ』は、廃校となった学校を探索し、怪異から逃げながら脱出を目指すシングルプレイヤー向け3Dホラーゲームです。探索中には「動くな」「高い場所へ逃げろ」「指定された色の場所へ向かえ」「隠れろ」など、さまざまな命令が突然発生します。暗い校舎を探索して鍵やアイテムを集め、安全な場所を見つけながら命令を乗り越えてください。怪異に見つかったときは、教室や廊下、階段を利用して追跡を振り切り、学校からの脱出を目指します。

releases.name: The Seven Beacons
releases.summary: An idle RPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. While you work, your party fights on its own through 22 zones toward the Demon King. On a short break, open the panel: gear, talents, farm, alchemy, forge, and seven beacons to defend.

releases.name: Menio
releases.summary: Care unit Pell can see that Runch needs help. MENIO says he isn't eligible. When its supervisor needs that same care, refusal starts to look like revenge. A short psychological horror visual novel about empathy, accountability, and institutional cruelty.

releases.name: Hero Tower Defense
releases.summary: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

releases.name: Prayer Chest
releases.summary: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

releases.name: Last Bake
releases.summary: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

releases.name: New Age War: Online
releases.summary: A first-person shooter where every bullet is a real projectile with its own speed and drop. Build your weapon from 34 guns, then fight online in lobbies of up to 16 players or against bots across a Mexican valley town, the Ukrainian steppe and an open sea of jets.

releases.name: Wand Keeper
releases.summary: Have you ever wanted to star in your own movie? Well now you can! ACT IT OUT is a new interactive game that lets you create, share and have fun with family and friends. Prove that you have what it takes to be part of Hollywood!Act It out makes you the director and the star in your own mini movie, but don’t give away the name of it. releases.name: Randal's Weekend
releases.summary: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.

releases.name: Maximum Aura
releases.summary: Farm aura. Bonk googly-eyed NPCs to a phonk beat. Do not get cooked. A frantic top-down arcade survival shooter: auto-fire, dash through crowds, stack ridiculous upgrades, and unleash BRAINROT MODE when your aura bar is full.

releases.name: Desert Cleaner
releases.summary: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

releases.name: Idol On Duty
releases.summary: A Beat-Em-Up starring a J-Pop-inspired magical girl Aiko who bashes corporate demons over the head while swapping between a Pop mode and a Metal mode.

releases.name: Fast Point
releases.summary: Fast Point is a pickup point business simulator where you start with a small location, a few shelves, and your first customers. Receive deliveries, organize packages in storage, hand out orders, process returns, and make sure the queue doesn't turn into chaos.

releases.name: Hidden Front
releases.summary: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

releases.name: My Galaxy Buddy
releases.summary: A relaxing idler that sits on your desktop. Interact with it on your own terms while you work on other tasks! Extract items from 8 unique biomes! Purchase upgrades to discover rare planets!Customize your UFO and extract items in style!Discover all biomes and collect every item to fill out your archive!

releases.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
releases.summary: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.

releases.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
releases.summary: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

releases.name: Celebria
releases.summary: Build a career in music, acting or both in this celebrity simulation, where your story unfolds through text and choices. Release singles and albums, audition for screen roles, climb global charts, headline tours, chase awards and launch businesses while navigating the pressures of fame.

releases.name: Resort Architect
releases.summary: Operate your own resort! Manage the hotel front desk, build guest rooms, prepare meals, run the bar, and design and construct everything yourself. Accumulate profits, continue to expand, and make your resort grow stronger day by day, becoming a popular choice!

releases.name: Musunoa: The Faceless
releases.summary:
Lanterns light the streets of Seirin for a night of celebration. Then the first houses catch fire. Soldiers emerge from the darkness, strike and vanish.

Ren refuses to let them escape. Pursuing the attackers, he discovers an entire army beyond the river. His village is still tending its wounded. If he loses the crossing, the attackers will reach its gates before the villagers can escape.

Alongside Aya, Ren enters a war that leads him back to the secrets of his own family. Behind enemy masks and the silence of those closest to him, he searches for the same answer: who can he still trust?

Take command in a turn-based strategy adventure. Hold the crossings, advance through the fog and prepare your attacks: the soldiers you lead are the last line of defense between your village and the approaching army.

releases.name: My Bookstore
releases.summary: Start with empty shelves and a dream in My Bookstore! Buy books, manage your inventory, serve customers, and grow your little shop into a thriving bookstore. Stock your shelves, ring up sales, and build the bookstore every book lover dreams of!

releases.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
releases.summary: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

releases.name: Rally Panic with the BRO!
releases.summary: One drives. One navigates. Both panic! Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.

releases.name: MEIFU KANSHIKI-KA: The Underworld Forensics Division
releases.summary: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

releases.name: Project Overboard
releases.summary: Design a cruise ship deck by deck, hire the crew and take paying guests out to sea. Keep them fed, entertained and away from reception while the buffet runs low, the lifts back up and somebody does something in the pool.

releases.name: You Can Sort It!
releases.summary: A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.

releases.name: Streaming Tycoon
releases.summary: Run a streaming company under a board that can fire you. Negotiate with stars, produce films, series and shows, and refresh your catalogue as audiences lose interest. Build a talent agency and choose which contracts, productions and risks are worth taking.

releases.name: Iron Reactor
releases.summary: A Soviet reactor has gone silent. Enter ZHELEZO in this dark retro FPS, battle radioactive mutants and uncover a reality beyond the walls. Fight through 24 levels across four acts, wield seven weapons and face endless enemy waves in Survival mode.

releases.name: Big Fox Family Time
releases.summary: A cozy first-person family sim where your fox family doubles every night. Hunt, chop, build a den and tuck your kits into bed, then command a crowd of thousands at once, from three kits up to 65,536. Play solo or in online co-op with up to four parents.

releases.name: Prison Legacy
releases.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

releases.name: Cats to Mars
releases.summary: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

releases.name: Stable Champs
releases.summary: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.

releases.name: Digbound
releases.summary: Dig. Sell. Upgrade. Dig deeper.

releases.name: Peaceward Chronicles
releases.summary: A turn-based card strategy game set in the Taiping Rebellion. Guided by Heaven, you become Hong Xiuquan, God's second son. Unlock characters, build a team, and exploit Five Elements matchups and formation bonuses. Complete six story chapters; unlock roguelike challenges after Chapter 2.

releases.name: Dejinochi
releases.summary: Raise a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world — though old friends might still come back to visit.
